faqs.a:
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Substance releasing toxic vapors
shall mean the following: Plastic (styrene) cements containing toluene, acetone,
               benzene, aliphatic acetates (such as, but not limited to, ethyl acetate and methylcellosolve
               acetate), hexacane or cyclo hexane; model cements containing acetone, toluene or naphtha
               of petroleum origin; cements containing toluene, acetone, isopropanol, methyl ethyl
               ketone or methyl isobutyl ketone; cosmetics containing acetone aliphatic acetates,
               benzene or alcohol; paint, lacquer or similar substance thinners containing toluene,
               aliphatic acetates or methyl, ethyl or propyl alcohol; lighter and cleaning fluids
               containing naphtha of petroleum origin, perchlorethylene, trechlorethane or carbon
               tetrachloride; or any other liquid or substance of any nature whatsoever containing
               any of the above mentioned toxic materials.
(Code 1981, § 21-56; Ord. No. 738, § 1, 10-21-1968)
